title: 1991 paper on technology-assisted consciousness circulated in aerospace and CIA

tellings.quote: 1991 I wrote a paper went all through the aerospace industry and CIA which kind of also put me on the radar

plain: A researcher named Steven Greer says that in 1991 he wrote a paper about using technology together with human consciousness to make contact with extraterrestrials, ideas also found in his writing titled Extraterrestrial Contact: The Evidence and Implications. He says the paper spread throughout the aerospace industry and the CIA, the US Central Intelligence Agency, and that this is part of what put him on their radar. If so, insiders were paying attention to his work from early on.
